33. In his cross 'on behalf of the accused DIG Mizan, he stated that this report was submitted by the order of Assistant Commissioner Land. This order is not along with the exhibited documents filed by him. This is also not mentioned in his report but mentioned in the description. Attached documents one mere photocopy but not attested by him, though all are attested by the land Assistant. All the documents or papers with the report submitted by his singed are prior to 6-3-18. It is alleged that he has given the report without taking out the updated documents regarding the information that has been asked about the concerned property. He didn't take it because it was not necessary for him. He denied that his submitted report dated 6-3-18 is not partially true. He did not mentioned about the D.S Khatian because it is not published yet.
